| w3-devstack-e2e follow-up 32 | Isolation 19's F19-02. On exactly HTTP 412 RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT the shared publisher re-reads the node: if the re-read already has the intended values the command succeeds with no further write, otherwise it retries with the fresh ETag, the same Idempotency-Key and the same body. At most three writes and ten seconds per command; other statuses, other 412 codes, a failed re-read and transport errors stop at once, and Go's implicit replays and redirects are off for these writes. The same key is valid because the idempotency reservation shares the action's transaction: a 412 rolls both back, and only durable successes are stored. Every attempt and re-read is recorded with UTC times, sent If-Match, status, code and body SHA-256. Eight owned node-write sites use the helper; four writes no observation can race stay unchanged. Live: the first forced invocation (e22872b7) died before enrollment when the lane's admission wrapper put free into Docker's JSON output; ordinary c52b760c passed 8/8. Resumed under the orchestrator's one-invocation authorization: af726b13 recovered from both 412s but its own proof check wrongly demanded a version detail, fixed with a stub test and retained blocked; forced 95fb7eab sent "0" on the capacity PATCH and the publication PUT, each got a real 412, one re-read and a same-key retry returning 202, and passed 8/8; ordinary 3ad796d4 passed 8/8 with no conflict. The zero header is rejected before any version lookup, so the observation race itself is not reproduced. Requests: the AT-owned node-write sites to their owners (isolation's six go to isolation 20); the API owner reviews the contract's "0" pattern and the empty 412 details. Session on codex gpt-6-astra, resumed once. | done (#438) |
